PDF / Drucken Teilen Veröffentlichungsdatum: Vor 30+ Tagen veröffentlicht Stellenbeschreibung A Snapshot of Your Day As a Supplier Quality Engineer within Siemens Energy and the business area Grid Technologies, you play a key role in ensuring that our global suppliers meet all technical, quality, and regulatory requirements for electrical and electronic components and assembled products. You collaborate closely with cross-functional commodity teams, procurement, and engineering to conduct supplier qualifications, audits, and assessments. By driving supplier development and monitoring performance, you actively contribute to the successful implementation of our supply strategy and the continuous improvement of our global supplier base. In our multicultural and international environment, no two days are the same. Your work directly supports the energy transition by ensuring high-quality components for our global grid solutions. How You’ll Make an Impact * Overall responsibility for all relevant SQM elements for electrical and electronic parts and assembled components within cross-functional teams * Coordination and leadership of supplier quality activities in alignment with commodity strategy and global factory network * Implementation and management of the Supplier Product and Process Qualification (SPPQ) process * Execution of supplier audits according to IMS standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and VDA 6.3 * Management of commodity-specific non-conformance processes including root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions * Initiation and execution of supplier development measures as well as negotiation and implementation of Quality Assurance Agreements What You Bring * Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Electrical Engineering or a comparable field * Several years of professional experience in Supplier Quality Management, Quality Management, or a technical function, ideally in electrical and electronic components and assemblies * Strong knowledge of relevant international standards for electrical and electronic products * Proven experience in auditing (Lead Auditor or 1st/2nd party auditor according to ISO 9001, preferably ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and VDA 6.3) * Experience in root cause analysis and other quality and risk management methodologies * Excellent communication and negotiation skills in German and English, combined with willingness to travel internationally About the Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme * We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder * We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity * The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose * In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO Arbeitsorte Karte anzeigen 13629 Berlin Unternehmensdarstellung: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co.
